# اِكْتَشَفْتَ (iktašafta) /ik.ta.ʃaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# اِكْتَشَفْتِ (iktašafti) /ik.ta.ʃaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# اِكْتَشَفَتْ (iktašafat) /ik.ta.ʃa.fat/: third-perso
